propositions: code-review verdicts never record provider_provenance, leaving only a bare model string and omitting provider, endpoint host, and support tier attribution
the terminal verdict assembled by code_review_coach carries no provenance key, and finalize_code_review_verdict only adds cfg-derived runner and model defaults, mirroring story 343b gap 5 defect

provider_provenance must be threaded from the Pass-2 verify agent step (which receives the runner result containing the stamped record) through to the terminal verdict assembly, not recomputed at the verdict site
the outage path _degraded_code_review_verdict must omit provider_provenance entirely rather than synthesizing one from cfg, to avoid misattribution when no model ran
real integration tests must verify the complete path from code-review.yaml wiring through the actual verdict assembly to sidecar payload serialization, not hand-built verdicts
